notes.title: The full version of Cruise Ship Manager will launch on May 24th!
notes.notes:
Ahoy, prospective shipowners!

The stay in port is coming to an end. By this point, you're without a doubt ready to open up your cruise business. You had a chance for a test run with the prologue for Cruise Ship Manager. You have earned your know-how and now the time is coming to use it. The sea is calling you to sail out in search of a great reputation and even greater profits, because...

[h2]Cruise Ship Manager will be available on May 24th![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41290111/46d9b6fcb03bdabf974d3bf87b966e54984b32cf.jpg[/img]

Just a reminder of what you can expect from the full version of the game:
A cruise ship of your own that you can customize to your liking

Resource management (provisions, fuel, budget, etc.)

[list]
[*] An incredible variety of unique passengers with different expectations and behaviors
[*] Crew members with their skillsets, which they improve during cruises
[*] Route selection between well-known Mediterranean tourism hotspots
[*] Many unique, luxurious rooms to add to your ship, such as restaurants, clubs, casinos, gyms, swimming pools, and more
[*] Real-time cruise management with solving sudden issues by fixing damaged equipment, cleaning the rooms, extinguishing fires, etc.
[*] Reputation-based progression, which depends on happiness goals for each cruise
[*] Unlimited fun on a deep blue sea!
[/list]
And, what's most important, you will be able to enjoy all of those features at [b]a very attractive price of $9.99! [/b]So let's all meet on 24th May as blooming sea-faring entrepreneurs!
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: What kind of rooms you can expect from full version of Cruise Ship Manager?
notes.notes:
Ahoy, shipowners!

Thanks to the Cruise Ship Manager prologue, you had a lot of time to get to grips with the basics of setting up your cruise empire. We hope your first 6 cruises went smoothly! You also had an occasion to add some basic service and entertainment rooms to your first ship. Of course, there are more options in this department in the full version of the game. Today, we will take a look at some of the advanced rooms that you'll be able to expand your ship with - for the pleasure of your passengers and profit!

[h2]Advanced rooms on the ship[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251420/Cruise_Ship_Manager_Prologue__Maiden_Voyage/

One of the options you've asked frequently about was to automatize some of the cleaning/fixings to make it more manageable on long cruises. The answer to this issue is the [b]Storage room[/b], in which [b]the Janitor[/b] works. During the cruise, you can set patrol routes for them, so they will monitor certain rooms automatically. You can select up to 10 rooms to be part of the Janitor's patrol. 

With several Storages, you can cover most of even the biggest ship in the game. Just remember - there is only one Janitor per Storage, and he has his own tempo. So if you want something to be done quicker, it may be wise to assign an employee currently closer to the thing needing attention.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41290111/e253f3f4939290e15bae8ce5781e5d753e84920a.gif[/img]

Everyone loves splishing and splashing! In Cruise Ship Managers you have [b]two options to open a pool to your passengers - either outdoor or indoor.[/b] Lots of people love to spend time actively, so swimming a few lengths will be an attractive prospect to them. Others just like to sit and soak while the sun shines on them. The outdoor option is perfect for those relax-first types. 

Don't forget that you can also set up some water slides next to the outdoor pool and turn the upper deck into a real Mediterranean paradise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41290111/032f0a9d0525048533c027c2d5cc56635dbe5629.gif[/img]

[b]The Casino [/b]has probably the most to offer in term of entertainment options for people who like to spice up their cruise with some gambling. This room offers slot machines, two poker tables and blackjack to test the luck of your passengers. There are also additional options to attract customers. You can activate the Double Payout for the slot machines. Card players will be eager to know that there is an option of participating in a Poker tournament.

Just remember that this room requiries a lot of employees to work properly. You will need four croupiers and a security worker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41290111/6b8b5b3c22cb2812a51bf805dae3ab447f85e7a1.gif[/img]

Are you eager to add those rooms to your perfect cruise ship? These and more will be available at various ports of the full game, coming soon!

notes.title: New Cruise Ship Manager prologue patch 1.18 available to download
notes.notes:
Ahoy, shipowners!

Today another patch will be available, addressing bugs surrounding the game's NPCs and other interaction issues. Patch notes below and enjoy even smoother gameplay!

[h2]Patch 1.18 live today[/h2]

The changes in the patch include:
[list]
[*] Navigation now indicates Cannot Reach Destination instead of Destination Reached when trying to move a disabled/not existing room
[*] More secure AI deciding when to use the teleporting of NPCs
[*] Clothes change-related improvements (better resetting)
[*] Fixed a teleport interaction, which finished without releasing NPC.
[*] Adjusted order of activating NPC modules when placing them on the ship at the start of the cruise.
[*] Fix for a visual bug with the tickets panel sometimes showing incorrectly rounded up max ticket pool
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.14 available now for Cruise Ship Manager: Prologue - Maiden Voyage
notes.notes:
Ahoy, shipowners!

A new patch landed today for our prologue. It addresses some common issues, as well as implements some minor changes in general UI and how the game communicates certain things to players. You can also enjoy new hotkeys for even better camera control.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251420/Cruise_Ship_Manager_Prologue__Maiden_Voyage/

The changes in the patch include:
[list]
[*] Added camera scrolling with +/- hotkeys
[*] Adjusted texts where they didn't fit the frame in some languages
[*] Added missing translations
[*] Fix to not being able to sell tickets while having negative money
[*] Change to the order of events happening during fire extinguishing to eliminate the bug preventing from completing the task
[*] Disabled translucent warning image spamming, which could be affecting FPS
[*]  Fix to room UI not loading
[*] Allowed selection through walls
[*] Added the tooltips for the color palette and hired crew list
[*] Build mode music now changes to a new track when the first one finishes
[*] Fix to not being able to pick big cabin variant/color in Dubrovnik
[*] Harbor information on the map blocks rooms not available in the demo from appearing
[/list]
